candidate: Co-MTP non-oracle ego and infrastructure future replacement

reasons: The paper constructs ego planning input from the true ego future, including quintic interpolation of that future; this is not an online planner proposal.

The paper describes other-agent futures as infrastructure-only predictions, while the public preprocessing path extracts future labels and no matching prediction-to-loader entry point or checkpoint was verified.
The public README command, argparse flags, checkpoint default, training-mode call, absolute data paths, and preprocessing schemas contain independent execution blockers.
Neither the audited Co-MTP repository nor the V2X-Seq repository exposes a verified applicable license.

paperEvidence: The vehicle-side model input includes historical trajectories, AV future ground truth, and map context.
The paper uses a quintic curve over the true ego future to simulate a planning trajectory.
The experiment uses 3 seconds of history and 5 seconds of future at 5 Hz.

codeEvidence.finding: Extracts up to 50 true future ego frames into AV_fut.
Loads, downsamples, transforms, and inserts the future into future-agent nodes and planning edges.

paperEvidence: The paper states that other-agent futures are predicted by an infrastructure-only Co-MTP model.

codeEvidence.finding: Builds other_fut_fea, other_fut_mask, and other_fut_type from future labels.
The loader instead expects other_label, other_auxiliary_label, and other_label_mask.

otherFuture.unresolved: No public converter from an infrastructure-only predictor output to the loader schema was verified.

infrastructureHistory.finding: The training loader expects tar_id, road_feature, road_feature_mask, road_ids, and road_type, while preprocess_road.py emits a different payload containing agent_feature, label, auxiliary_label, label_mask, pred_num, object_id_lis, agent_type, and map_fea.

publicExecutionBlockers.finding: The README invokes python train.py, but the repository root has no train.py; the file is training/train.py.
The published command passes True or False to flags implemented with action=store_false, so argparse rejects the documented values.
The default checkpoint is the string None, but the no-checkpoint condition compares against lowercase none, causing an attempted load of a path named None.
The epoch loop calls run_model with is_train=false, bypassing backward, optimizer step, and checkpoint-save paths.
Default dataset and map paths point to author-local absolute paths; one data_path default also contains an extra quote.
The public preprocessing outputs do not satisfy the public training loader contract for road observations and other futures.

evidence: The official repository has no release or tag containing a checkpoint.
The only checkpoint-related tree hit is the local-load argument in training/train.py.
The official issue requesting pretrained weights remains open without a verified asset.

dataset.name: V2X-Seq-TFD
notes: The repository publishes example and full-dataset Google Drive links.
No archive download, checksum, capacity audit, or loader-compatible sample run completed in this audit.

licenses.boundary: A license from the parent DAIR-V2X code repository cannot be projected onto the sequence dataset without explicit terms.

minimumNonOracleVerticalSlice.scope: A contract and execution audit, not a faithful-paper reproduction.
steps: Define one loader-compatible sample contract containing no values from t greater than t0.
Replace AV_fut with a history-only constant-acceleration or external planner-proposal adapter and log its provenance.
Replace other futures with an infrastructure-history-only constant-velocity adapter before attempting any learned predictor.
Repair the documented CLI, checkpoint condition, training mode, paths, and preprocessing schema without changing model semantics.
Pass one-batch forward, finite loss, backward, optimizer step, checkpoint save, reload, and identical deterministic inference.
Add no-future, top-1 proposal, oracle-future, and fully marginalized controls only after the non-oracle path runs.
goGates: A sample can be produced and loaded with a machine-checkable proof that no t greater than t0 truth enters any input.
The one-batch train-save-reload smoke test passes from a clean environment.
The ego and other-future adapters have explicit shapes, coordinate frames, time horizons, and missing-data behavior.
The public-data license permits the planned use.
noGoGates: Any future label, oracle ego trajectory, or post-t0 map-derived state remains in a claimed deployment input.
The loader contract cannot be reconstructed from public assets.
The only viable experiment requires the unpublished checkpoint or author-local preprocessing artifacts.
The contribution reduces to fixing repository bugs without a separate scientific hypothesis.
